ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) base pigment to high-intensity (white) distal patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe distal region contains diffuse, high-contrast white mottling. Right lobe distal region features a large contiguous white patch intersected by vertical low-intensity finger-like projections extending from the central lobe body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:1.2 relative to the immediate inner lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge is predominantly smooth/linear from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations at the distal tips caused by epibiont accumulation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to significantly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular geometric protrusions (barnacles) concentrated heavily on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy epibiont colonization on the distal tips, altering the natural geometric silhouette of the fluke edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical striation pattern of dark pigment within the white distal field of the right lobe.
